svg.title: W419. Ticketmaster-Style Seat Booking Design — architecture
svg.desc: Seat-map client ← snapshot/deltas ← cached availability view ↓ hold selected IDs Hold API → event-seat SQL transaction → hold ID + deadline/version ↓ checkout Protected payment workflow → sold seats + order/ticket outbox ↓ Client pending / confirmed state + replayable events
